# PR Review Checklist

Review the diff for:

- [ ] Correctness bugs
- [ ] Edge cases not handled
- [ ] Security issues
- [ ] Unnecessary complexity
- [ ] Missing tests
- [ ] Unclear naming
- [ ] Broken existing behaviour
- [ ] Accessibility problems
- [ ] Performance regressions

## Issue Format

For each issue found, include:

1. File and line number
2. Description of the problem
3. Why it matters
4. Suggested fix
